network_advisories.headline: Reduced arrival rate at LIS due to runway resurfacing programme, 04:00-09:00 local daily until 2026-08-14. Expect 15-30 minute holding on morning arrivals.

Freezing fog forecast at EDI from 17:00 local. RVR expected below Cat I minima. Carriers advised to expect widespread cancellation of evening rotations. Airport-declared low visibility procedures in force.
Convective activity over BCN terminal area. Ground stop declared 06:10-11:40 local. All arrivals holding or diverting to MAD/GRO.
Dublin arrivals flow restriction, 20-minute average delay, expected to clear by 14:00 local.
Crew availability pressure at LHR following 2026-08-04 disruption. Standby pool exhausted on short-haul European rosters. Operations advise elevated risk of same-day cancellation.
Two widebody and three narrowbody unserviceabilities at LGW. Engineering resource saturated. Accommodation demand at LGW expected to exceed contracted allocation tonight.
Planned industrial action by third-party baggage handling contractor at AMS, 2026-08-09. Not Aerlink-employed staff.

LHR-LIS rotation suspended for 2026-08-08 following crew unavailability. Next own-metal service 2026-08-10. Partner re-accommodation authorised for affected passengers subject to Section 8 of APCP-2026-04.

flight_events.detail: Cabin pressurisation fault. 132 passengers re-accommodated onto AK644 same date. 14 passengers downgraded from Business to Economy owing to cabin configuration difference.
Knock-on from AK640. Departed 55 minutes late.
Engine borescope inspection required. 168 passengers re-accommodated onto AK309.
Departed 40 minutes late.
Departed 65 minutes late.

Freezing fog at EDI, RVR below operating minima. Cancellation decision taken 16:55Z. Operating crew were on stand and within duty hours at the time of the decision; crew availability was not a factor.
Freezing fog at EDI.
Operated normally, arrived 8 minutes late. Two mobility devices offloaded at LHR; one reported by handling agent as damaged in transit, damage report DR-EDI-4471 raised.
BCN ground stop. 174 passengers affected.
BCN ground stop.
Flap actuator fault. Passengers re-accommodated onto AK448.
Contracted handler unable to provide loading crew. Departed 140 minutes late.
Dublin flow restriction. Departed 95 minutes late.
Inbound rotation failure.
Hydraulic system fault found on pre-flight inspection. No replacement airframe at MAN. 189 passengers affected.
Operating crew out of hours. No standby crew at LHR. See ADV-2026-0805-A.
Commercial cancellation, passengers consolidated onto AK315.
APU failure, aircraft unserviceable at stand.
Air conditioning system fault. 151 passengers affected. Next BCN-LHR service AK420 2026-08-06 08:40.
Avionics fault rectified at stand. Departed 215 minutes late, arrived 195 minutes late.
Nosewheel steering fault. No further LGW-FCO service this date. 164 passengers requiring overnight accommodation.
Fuel system fault on turnaround. No spare widebody at LGW. 271 passengers affected, majority requiring overnight accommodation. See ADV-2026-0806-A.
Departed 50 minutes late.
Cargo door seal failure. 244 passengers affected, including 3 Young Traveller Programme passengers requiring YTP desk handling.
Departed 35 minutes late.
Captain reported unfit to fly. No standby captain at LHR. LHR-LIS suspended for remainder of date; next own-metal service AK588 2026-08-10. See ADV-2026-0808-A.
Return leg of AK588 rotation.
